name: 2.0.0-test-rc8 focused checklist
description: Focused acceptance checks for changes added after the RC7 test image.

items.name: RC8 identity and clean startup
items.description: Test: Fresh-pull or update the candidate, open the dashboard, /api/health, /api/system, /api/plugins, and restart once. Pass: Health is 200, every surface reports 2.0.0-test-rc8, intended plugins load, and workspace state persists.

items.name: Three clear Review sets
items.description: Test: Open Review > Suggested and inspect 1.9.9 regression, 2.0.0 previous RCs, and 2.0.0-test-rc8 before starting each. Pass: Exactly these three non-overlapping sets are available, every check states Test and Pass instructions, and each set remains a separate release tab.

items.name: Separate Suggested discovery
items.description: Test: In Guardrails, Evals, Optimize, and Review, switch Active/Archived/Suggested; search, filter, sort, view details, and Use one suggestion. Pass: Suggestions never appear in Active, controls affect only Suggested, counts are correct, and Use returns to Active with an editable created item.

items.name: Fast cached suggestions
items.description: Test: Open Suggested once in each plugin, navigate away and back several times, then choose Actions > Refresh after changing or mounting a suggestion file if available. Pass: First load may fetch, repeat visits render immediately without the prior three-second blank state, and explicit Refresh picks up file changes.

items.name: Persistent plugin navigation order
items.description: Test: Drag plugin navigation into a new order, place Review somewhere else, refresh, then test in a second browser profile. Pass: The first profile restores its chosen order, a new profile uses defaults with Review last, and every plugin remains navigable.

items.name: Review export handoff
items.description: Test: Complete/pass/fail several checks, add notes and evidence, then export with reviewer name/email and the correct local, cloud, or on-prem environment. Pass: The named Markdown includes only the selected set, outcomes, notes, evidence, timestamp, instance/version details, and sanitized recent errors with no secrets.

items.name: Mobile plugin toolbar and dialogs
items.description: Test: At 390px width, open every plugin, switch all views and collection tabs, open Actions/Create/details and the Review export dialog. Pass: View controls occupy a stable row, Create/Actions remain visible, dialogs scroll internally, text wraps, and no control or page content is clipped.

items.name: Automated and image release gate
items.description: Test: Run integration with validation and coverage, then inspect candidate image jobs and smoke both public and authorized private images where credentials are available. Pass: All tests pass, coverage does not regress unexpectedly, amd64/arm64 jobs are green, and each image exposes only its intended plugin inventory.
